bug_in_step11: Compared a model trained on the FULL 5592-row training set (0.9241 AUROC) against models retrained on only a 1678-row reserve + 20 new labels — the ~70% data reduction, not the sampling strategy, explained the apparent AUROC drop. This made active learning look harmful when it wasn't being fairly tested.
headline_metric_to_use: 100% vs 2% base-rate fraud capture in the uncertain batch is the clean, uncontested result. The AUROC delta between random and uncertainty sampling is noisy at n=20 and should be presented as directional, not a definitive win.
